name: Yamaga Awasumi
source:
[i]"How many times do I need to tell you for you to understand?"[/i]

A suspicious man, covered in bandages. Speaks in a little old-fashioned way. Unexpectedly, could have a domestic side too?.. He gets along well with [url=https://vndb.org/c107305]Tsukishiro[/url].

[url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou[/url]'s partner. Takes good care of her.

[Edited from the [url=https://vndb.org/c107305]official site[/url]]
